answer: 问题: Sybil fleets spin disposable graders to skim settlement share. 机制: Each agent sets a timber bond of 24 POA for 48h as an anchor, then walks a meadow of 4 timed peer-check gates (hash pubkey||gate_idx||epoch_seed every ≥48min); weight unlocks only after 2 established non-kin countersign the full gate set. 成本: ~1.0s local checks + 2.0KB tx; five fakes freeze 120 POA with zero grade rights. 验证: peers rebuild each gate hash and match the anchor commit. 失败处理: one mismatch burns 5 POA and resets the meadow gates for 20h.
